about: Labelled router turns (docs/DESIGN.md §3.4) for tests/integration/test_router_eval.py. Each case: the utterance, a short history ([role, text] or [role, text, heard_text] for an interrupted answer), the conversation state's topics, the expected intent (plus acceptable alternatives) and words the standalone query / English query must contain (any of each inner list). Live-data cases (§3.7) also give the expected tools (decided by application code from live-data cues, checked without the model in tests/test_live_routing.py) and words the web search query must contain.
